title: Only about 150 of 40,000 Ashurbanipal tablets translated
summary: Matt tells of Only about 150 of 40,000 Ashurbanipal tablets translated, about 7th century BC to present at Library of Ashurbanipal, Nineveh, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the 40,000 Ki form tablets at the Asher Bop Paul Library around 150 have been translated out of 40,000

plain: The Library of Ashurbanipal was a collection gathered by an ancient king at the city of Nineveh, in what is now Iraq, written on clay tablets in cuneiform, the wedge-shaped script of the ancient Middle East. A researcher named Matt says that of the roughly 40,000 tablets, only about 150 have been translated. If so, most of what those ancient writers recorded would still be unread.
